title: Count Pairs With XOR in a Range
summary: Determine the count of pairs (i, j) in an array where the bitwise XOR of nums[i] and nums[j] falls within a specified range [low, high], with i < j.
statement: Determine the count of pairs (i, j) in an array where the bitwise XOR of nums[i] and nums[j] falls within a specified range [low, high], with i < j.
constraints: Count index pairs i<j whose XOR lies in the inclusive range [low,high].
Values and bounds are positive and at most twenty thousand.
hints: Count XOR values below a limit, then subtract two prefix counts.
Insert earlier values in a binary trie and query each new value bit by bit.
For a one bit in limit, count the branch that keeps XOR zero and continue through the XOR-one branch.
The trie partitions all earlier numbers by the first differing XOR bit, so below(high+1)-below(low) counts exactly each valid pair once.
editorial: The trie partitions all earlier numbers by the first differing XOR bit, so below(high+1)-below(low) counts exactly each valid pair once.

tests.explanation: All six index pairs have XOR between two and six.
Exactly eight of the ten pairs fall within the requested range.
